en: A black and white photograph showing a lakeside scene, with several people, including children, walking along a sandy beach. There is a diving platform with a slide going into the lake, surrounded by trees and a few buildings. In the background, hills rise with what appears to be a large hotel or sanatorium on top. There are sunbathers in deck chairs, and the overall atmosphere is that of a classic European summer holiday spot.
